parsed_json.up: Select activity rows for target CHEMBL4247 with standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and non-null pchembl_value. Join activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter target_type to 'SINGLE PROTEIN' and target_dictionary tax_id to 9606. Return molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, target_type, tax_id, standard_type, pchembl_value. Do not deduplicate. Order by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id.
